facts.fact: MyJoyOnline says the Data Protection Commission has started enforcing the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843), whose registration provisions it cites (sections 27, 50 and 56).
The Data Protection Commission is reported at work enforcing Act 843, with an Executive Director, Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo, quoted.

On 12 October 2026 the Commission inspected a clinic, which was directed to give a statement to the police, and two hospitals with expired certificates, and a microfinance company was referred to CID over a lapsed registration; it recorded 2,575 registrations in 2026.
